title: Fifth environment shape (semantic_dom, L4) and the addressability boundary

cli_exec.note: ~95ms is the confinement boundary; declared budget of <50ms was optimistic by ~2x

measured.demonstration: click box, type 'urgent', click APPLY (the r82 browser sequence)
measured.random_access_note: 3 of 4 goals had never been executed; only 'urgent' was demonstrated

four_defects_found_all_reported_success.because: layer=='click' matched neither the UI branch nor any executable branch
the typed value was not quoted in the goal so it was never a candidate; the skill would type 'urgent' forever -- a recording

four_defects_found_all_reported_success.symptom: ok:true with the literal string '?str_loose0' submitted
four_defects_found_all_reported_success.because: execute_compiled_steps never called _instantiate_obj; bindings were the caller's unenforced duty

four_defects_found_all_reported_success.symptom: ok:true and 'Inbox - 5 shown' for a goal that wanted 3
four_defects_found_all_reported_success.because: the executor treated every CLICK_SEMANTIC as a submit and dropped the value

cross_layer_regression_caught.defect: fixing is_ui broke Layer 3: cli_exec trace produced 5 steps instead of 1
cross_layer_regression_caught.because: has_direct_causal_shortcut was computed before the loop, so a cli_exec still in raw_steps could not count as the shortcut

the_boundary.statement: Layer 4 is a skill exactly when the postcondition is addressable. A filter whose state is in the URL has an exact postcondition and elevates. A filter whose state exists only in the DOM (onclick toggling row display) has no addressable state.

discriminator.client_side_8895: no URL reproduces the filtered state; both parameters ignored

the_boundary.executor_behaviour_on_the_js_page: refuses loudly with NO_SEMANTIC_FORM_AT_URL -- no silent success
the_boundary.why_it_cannot_be_recovered: the vision channel's CDP allowlist has no Runtime.evaluate; a client-side filter can be SEEN but not ADDRESSED

failure_class: a success flag is not a postcondition
